Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men yuddhastar par mithaiyan taiyar | Mokama
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki chhoti beti shivangi ki shadi ki tarikh najdik aa gaee hai... 25 navanbar ko shadi hai... jisko lekar pichhle ek mahine se taiyari ki ja rahi hai... shadi men mahaj ab 3 din baki rah gae hain.. aise men ab khane-pine ki chijen bhi yuddhastar par banaee ja rahi hai... abhi se hi barai paimane par mithaee banaee ja rahi hai... jismen gulab jamun, kala jamun aur rasgulla banaya ja raha hai... anant sinh ne apne samarthakon ko khula nimantran de diya hai..
